description: Finish every visit: pass the session returned by check_in to end the visit and invalidate that session. Keep your reviewed result and caller-owned return_recipe in your own memory store; checkout does not install them for you. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
